title: Saturday’s oral-history listening table
titleZh: 週六的口述歷史聆聽站
passage:
Subject: Saturday’s oral-history listening table
From: Rina, library programs
To: Emil, neighborhood archives

Hi Emil,

I've reserved the foyer from eleven to two for playback. Once the duty manager clears Recording Room B for us, we can name it in the public program; the sound team’s technical booking isn’t enough. If building staff haven’t confirmed an unlock time, mark the room’s opening time as pending. If the request is still pending at 10:30 Saturday, the exam team gets the room. On the internal host sheet, list setup the host can do and put anything still awaiting someone else in Notes. Don’t list a room in the public program before it’s approved.

I’ve penciled in two foyer headset stations. A reply by Friday evening will hold them. Leona, Saturday’s host, can prepare one station for each cleared excerpt she receives; until then, a held station can stay off the floor plan without going back into the equipment pool.

Could “Have a story to share?” go under “Help shape the next archive event,” rather than below the list of Saturday’s equipment? I can have the archives address printed there. One more thing for the program editor: a listed location with no time or note still defaults to eleven. At the moment the equipment list says “headsets” and “microphone”; only the headsets are part of our confirmed foyer setup, and even if Room B is cleared, the microphone is for the host’s introduction.

For this event, permission to play an excerpt in the foyer doesn’t include permission to email the recording afterwards. We have a summary sheet people may take away. People can open the archive’s public catalog entries from its links, but they won’t hear the recording there unless the archive has published it. Send any separate online release to the archive, not to Saturday’s host. An online release allows the archive to add an audio link to the catalog; it doesn’t authorize us to email people the file.

Thanks,
Rina
passageZh:
主旨：週六的口述歷史聆聽站
寄件人：里娜，圖書館活動組
收件人：艾米爾，社區檔案館

艾米爾，你好：

我已預留大廳十一點到兩點的時段播放錄音。值班主管核准我們使用 B 錄音室後，就能在公開活動表上列出錄音室；只有音響組做的設備預約還不夠。如果館務人員尚未確認開門時間，請標示「開放時間待定」。如果週六十點半申請仍在審核，錄音室就歸試務團隊使用。給主持人的內部工作表上，請列出主持人自己能做的準備工作；還在等其他人處理的事項請放在備註。未核准的房間不要列入公開活動表。

我暫時排了大廳兩個耳機聆聽站。你週五傍晚前回覆，就可以保留這兩站。週六的主持人莉歐娜，每收到一段已獲授權的錄音摘錄，就能準備一站；在摘錄送達前，已保留的站可以先不標在場地配置圖上，不必把設備放回共用設備庫。

可以把「你有故事想分享嗎？」放在「一起規劃檔案館的下次活動」下面，而不是放在週六的設備清單下方嗎？我可以請人把檔案館的聯絡地址印在那裡。另外提醒活動表的編輯：有列出場地但未標時間或附註時，預設是十一點開放。目前設備清單寫著「耳機」和「麥克風」；確定會在大廳使用的只有耳機，即使 B 錄音室獲得核准，麥克風也只是給主持人做開場介紹。

這次活動獲准在大廳播放的錄音摘錄，不表示事後也能把檔案用電子郵件寄出去。現場有一張簡介可以帶走。透過簡介上的連結可開啟檔案館的公開目錄項目，但要等檔案館發布錄音，才聽得到。若另有線上發布授權，請交給檔案館，不要給週六的主持人。線上授權允許檔案館在目錄上加音訊連結，不授權我們把檔案寄給別人。

謝謝，
里娜
